entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: The khan of the Abzan tribe on Tarkir who submitted to the dragons and gave up the clan name, kin-trees and the title of Khan.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A tribe on Tarkir nearly exterminated by Dromoka's brood.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of the dragon storms and clans.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who returned to the past to save Ugin from Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker whose life Sarkhan saved and who was sent into deep slumber.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The threat from whom Sarkhan saved Ugin.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragon who led genocide against the Abzan and forged a pact with Daghatar.

entities.name: Remembrance
entities.description: Daghatar's amber-headed mace binding spirits of Abzan ancestors, the last remnant of the first kin-tree.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: The newly appointed khan of the "true" Abzan, killed at a meeting in Jeskai territory.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon who attacked the khans' meeting.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon who attacked the khans' meeting.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The event after which the plane's new order under the dragons began.

events.summary: After Sarkhan saves Ugin and Ugin sleeps, dragon storms intensify and Dromoka's brood carries out a systematic genocide of the Abzan.
events.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan

events.summary: Daghatar consults Remembrance and decides to parley with Dromoka, though the ancestral spirits plan to ambush her.
events.quote: decided to hold an audience with Dromoka

events.summary: Daghatar learns why the dragons massacred the Abzan, shatters Remembrance releasing the spirits, and ends kin-trees and ancestor practices to forge a pact with Dromoka.
events.quote: Daghatar ordered the end of all kin-trees and spirit ancestor practices

events.summary: Dromoka forbids the words clan and khan, and Ojutai and Silumgar attack a meeting in Jeskai territory, killing Reyhan and the last chance of the true Abzan.
events.quote: Ojutai and Silumgar and their broods attacked the meeting, killing Reyhan

relations.quote: Daghatar was the khan of the Abzan tribe on Tarkir

relations.note: forged a pact and lived under her
relations.quote: thus forging a pact with the dragon
Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan

relations.note: newly appointed khan of the true Abzan
relations.quote: under the newly appointed khan Reyhan
